description: Image Description: The image depicts a residential street scene featuring two adjacent houses under a clear blue sky. On the left is a two-story, cream-colored house with a red roof and decorative architectural details typical of Victorian-style homes. The house has multiple windows with white frames, some of which have curtains visible inside. A small gabled entryway with a red roof shelters the front door, which is centered beneath a triangular pediment. Above the entrance, there is a bay window with a decorative wooden frame
